title: First Final Fantasy Resonance PS5 Review Released, Rough Campaign Length Revealed

Manage Topics News Square Enix PS5 Final Fantasy First Final Fantasy Resonance PS5 Review Released, Rough Campaign Length Revealed Is it resonating with critics? by Sammy Barker 10 hours ago Share: The heavy release schedule continues in earnest, and while we’re approaching the endgame for this year with GTA 6 next month, there’s plenty of enthusiasm for Square Enix’s upcoming HD-2D effort, Final Fantasy Resonance . Now, ahead of its release on 22nd October next week, Famitsu has published the throwback RPG’s first review – and it’s a good one. The Japanese publication’s panel decided on a score of 9/9/9/9, resulting in a very respectable 36/40. Questions have been asked about the iconic weekly magazine’s ratings over the years, but I played Resonance for over an hour earlier in the year , and I was broadly impressed with what I saw. I wouldn’t be surprised if it ends up around the 8 or 9 mark personally. Subscribe to Push Square on YouTube 172k The first official review for Final Fantasy Resonance has been published by Famitsu! - 9/9/9/9 [36/40] - Main story is about 20-30 hours - Full completion is 70 hours - Classic JRPG adventure pic.twitter.com/ODy55v8xIb - Genki✨ (@Genki_JPN) October 14, 2026 According to X user Genki , who’s a font of Japanese gaming knowledge, Famitsu also said the main campaign takes around 20 to 30 hours to complete. However, if you want to achieve 100% completion, you’re looking at around 70 hours. So it seems like the story will be quite breezy, but there’ll be plenty to dig your teeth into after if you want to see everything the game has to offer. It all sounds like positive stuff as far as I’m concerned. We’ll bring you our full review soon.
